about: [C13 critic] IV as the user plays it, in flow, by the good hand (lane C5's 'good', the desk): a movement after the first begins with what the last one left (no checkpoint go). Does the counted pocket (6 + 24 for the whole chapter, a fall's retry floored at 6 + 18) let good play win every movement first try? Run twice. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/critic/c13/iv_flow_good.json

steps.eval: (window.__says = [], setInterval(() => { const s = N.game.hud.sayShown, w = N.game.hud.warnText; const k = (s || '') + ' | ' + (w || ''); if (window.__says.at(-1)?.[1] !== k) { const r = N.game.player.weapons.impls.revolver; window.__says.push([+N.game.time.toFixed(1), k, N.game.scenes.beat, r.ammo, r.pocket]); } }, 100), 1)

steps.label: the good hand, in flow, wins every movement on the first try
